## Setup


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(bmm)
library(brms)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidybayes)
library(here)

source(here("_common.R"))  # shared workshop colors + ggplot theme
```
:::

## Load the fitted model

All workshop models ship pre-fitted in `models/` — nothing to compile,
nothing to wait for:

<!-- TODO (Chenyu): once m3_simple.rds is committed, remove `eval: false`
     here and in the chunks below so the rendered notebook shows the full
     worked analysis. -->


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
fit_m3 <- readRDS(here("models", "m3_simple.rds"))
```
:::
